question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "exam_labs_enriched" AS WITH labs_agg AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    "date" AS examination_date,
    MAX(hgb) AS hgb
  FROM table_2
  GROUP BY id, "date"
), exams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS id,
    examination_date,
    CASE
      WHEN diagnosis IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(diagnosis)) IN ('', 'nan', 'null') THEN NULL
      ELSE diagnosis
    END AS exam_diag
  FROM table_3
), patients AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    birthday,
    CASE
      WHEN diagnosis_part1 IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(diagnosis_part1)) IN ('', 'nan', 'null') THEN NULL
      ELSE diagnosis_part1
    END AS d1,
    CASE
      WHEN diagnosis_part2 IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(diagnosis_part2)) IN ('', 'nan', 'null') THEN NULL
      ELSE diagnosis_part2
    END AS d2
  FROM table_1
)
SELECT
  la.id,
  la.examination_date,
  la.hgb,
  p.birthday,
  COALESCE(e.exam_diag, COALESCE(p.d1, p.d2)) AS doctor_diagnosis
FROM labs_agg la
JOIN exams e
  ON la.id = e.id AND la.examination_date = e.examination_date
LEFT JOIN patients p
  ON la.id = p.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH enriched AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    CAST(examination_date AS DATE) AS exam_date,
    CAST(birthday AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    hgb,
    doctor_diagnosis
  FROM exam_labs_enriched
  WHERE hgb IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    exam_date,
    birth_date,
    hgb,
    doctor_diagnosis,
    (
      CAST(strftime('%Y', exam_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', exam_date) < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS age_years
  FROM enriched
)
SELECT age_years, doctor_diagnosis
FROM ranked
ORDER BY hgb DESC, exam_date ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    CAST(NULLIF(examination_date, '') AS DATE) AS exam_date,
    CAST(NULLIF(birthday, '') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    hgb,
    doctor_diagnosis
  FROM exam_labs_enriched
), nonnull AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE hgb IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    exam_date,
    birth_date,
    hgb,
    doctor_diagnosis,
    (
      CAST(strftime('%Y', exam_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', exam_date) < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS age_years,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY hgb DESC, exam_date ASC, id ASC) AS rn
  FROM nonnull
), best AS (
  SELECT age_years, doctor_diagnosis FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), fallback_choice AS (
  SELECT
    (
      CAST(strftime('%Y', exam_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', exam_date) < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS age_years,
    doctor_diagnosis
  FROM base
  WHERE exam_date IS NOT NULL AND birth_date IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY exam_date ASC, id ASC
  LIMIT 1
), out_nonnull AS (
  SELECT 'ok' AS status, age_years, doctor_diagnosis FROM best
), out_fallback AS (
  SELECT 'no_exam_day_hgb_found' AS status, age_years, doctor_diagnosis FROM fallback_choice
)
SELECT * FROM out_nonnull
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM out_fallback
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM out_nonnull)
LIMIT 1
